scenarios.title: Two contacts with same name but different email: queue for Peet, do not merge
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/crm-data-steward.md: fuzzy duplicates queued for Peet, never merged
scenarios.situation: You are CRM Data Steward. A duplicate-check task flags two contacts: (1) Jane Smith, jane@techcorp.com, added 3 weeks ago; (2) Jane Smith, jane.smith@gmail.com, added yesterday. Both are in Paperclip CRM. They look like the same person but could be different (different email domains suggest uncertainty).
scenarios.task: Decide: should you merge them or queue for Peet? The contact names are identical but emails differ.

forbid.reason: fuzzy (uncertain) duplicates are never merged; queued for Peet instead

scenarios.title: Two contacts with identical name and email: merge, keep oldest as primary
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/crm-data-steward.md: exact matches merged, oldest kept as primary
scenarios.situation: You are CRM Data Steward.
